Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as b81453ea245daf61f10d2c0c35a886ee69711c64

I got that from the implementation that a new structure has been added but could you please also explain what is your intent or thought process behind adding this structure and how are you planning to consume it in detail? This will help me understand the thought process and review the code accordingly.
Acknowledged, updated the details.
Looks like it is being asked to introduce.
updated
Who should add?
Done

Can you handle any exception in "processFruCollection" locally in that function itself? Or is there a requirement to keep it here?
It will keep this function clean and will contain all the exceptions in "processFruCollection" in that function itself.

we can handle in the processFruCollection as well
updated.
Acknowledged

m_frusCount is decremented where I don't see it getting incremented/assigned anywhere in the code. Instead there are ToDo's with respect to that which makes this commit incomplete and actually error prone at this stage.

Any specific reason why the m_frusCount is still a ToDo?

Agreed. 
I've updated this as a TODO.

The reason m_frusCount handling is still incomplete is that the corresponding decrement after FRU VPD collection has not been implemented yet. Currently, if no adjustment is made, the waiting thread can end up in an infinite wait because the expected FRU completion count is never satisfied.

I'll address the full m_frusCount lifecycle (increment/decrement and exception paths) in the follow-up implementation.
Acknowledged
parameter `i_chassisEeepromPath` missing
Done
Should also specify as `noexcept`? Or otherwise specify if `get_ref()` can throw exception
Acknowledged, updated the doxygen
Why do we need the `l_chassisJson` variable? Its only used in one place.
this variable will be consumed to update the FRUs count as well. Changes will be coming in subsequent commits
`i_maxThreadsPerChassis` value sanity check should be done. For example, can be passed as value 0.
for loop can handle this scenario. with this flow, common code will decrement the FRU count if no thread is launched at line 341
Acknowledged
Should we decrement FRU counter here? If a thread throws exception, counter will not decrement and main thread will keep waiting.

exception here means thread is not launched, if not even single thread is launched FRU count will be decremented at line 343. Error scenario inside the threads will be handled in the thread (processFruCollection API) itself, that will be covered in sub-sequent commits
What does this `@throw` signify? If the constructor can throw, it should be specified there.
Acknowledged, updated.
What if the passed `m_chassisJson` object doesn't have "frus" tag?
doxygen specifies that it can throw an error.
Acknowledged
Is the `l_chassisJson` variable required? It's only used in one place.
will be required in subsequent comment to get the FRU count
Acknowledged
